districts_primary: D19 (Kovan, Serangoon, Hougang, Bartley, Woodleigh, MacPherson)

tenure.99yr_allowed_if: (a) TOP within 10 years AND < 100 units, OR (b) larger project (up to ~500 units) where some 3BR units exceed 1,110 sqft (e.g. Kovan Residences)
tenure.99yr_lease_age_check: buyer_age + remaining_lease >= 95 (buyer age assumed 40 for this run)

criteria.psf_over_cap_handling: flag CAP EXCEEDED, do not exclude (new-build structurally pricier)

data_quality_global: All SG portals (PropertyGuru / 99.co / SRX / EdgeProp) returned 403 to direct fetch; every figure is triangulated from search-result snippets and must be re-verified live before any offer. Some listings carry 2025 / mid-2026 snippet dates and may be stale or already transacted. A few PSF figures are approximate where snippet price/size pairing was ambiguous.
label_corrections: Parc Elegance: buyer listed 'Lengkong Lima, Eunos (D14)' but the only Parc Elegance is at Telok Kurau Road, D15. Confirm intended project.

Oasis Garden: no condo named Oasis Garden exists at Lengkong Satu / Eunos (that street is landed). The only Oasis Garden condo is at Bunga Rampai Place, D19 (Bartley/Tai Seng). Confirm intended project.

The Waterline (D15 Tanjong Rhu): no freehold project of that exact name exists at Tanjong Rhu. Closest are Water Place (99-yr) and The Waterside (freehold). A real 'The Waterline' exists but is in D19 Hougang (Poh Huat Rd West). Confirm intended project.
Vibes @ East Coast: located on Telok Kurau Road (not Lengkong Tiga/Still Rd); it is a shoebox development with no 3BR above 850 sqft - recommend dropping from the 3BR >1,110 sqft watchlist.

pass.notes: Strongest clean fit in D19: under BOTH the price cap and the $1,700 PSF cap, freehold, built 2015. A second listing (1,259 sqft @ $2,180,000, PSF ~$1,731, CAP EXCEEDED) also passes on size+price.
999-yr = freehold-equivalent. Under both caps. Fresh listing (17 Aug 2026). All 3BR stacks (1,281-1,701 sqft) exceed 1,110 sqft. NOTE: this is the D19 Kovan project, not an East Coast one.

Large 1,410 sqft stack is a clean pass under both caps (PSF $1,576 — the sub-agent's ~$1,765 was an arithmetic error; 2,221,888 / 1,410 = 1,576). Additional 1,410 sqft listings reportedly at $1,999,999 ($1,418 psf) and $2,100,000 ($1,489 psf) — verify live. WARNING: the COMMON 3BR band (1,012-1,141 sqft) mostly FAILS the >1,110 size rule; only the big stack qualifies.

Only the 12 penthouse 3BRs (1,291-1,700 sqft) exceed 1,110 sqft; standard 3BR (732-915 sqft) all FAIL size. A second PH listing at $1,999,999 (~$1,510 psf) may be stale (Sep'25). A third at $2,300,000 (~$1,737) is AT the price cap -> NEEDS-CHECK.

Entire 3BR stock (1,184-1,615 sqft) exceeds 1,110 sqft. PSF over cap. Price anchor: a 1,184 sqft unit resold 12 Mar 2026 at $2,130,000 ($1,799 psf) - below current $2.25M asking. A $2,300,000 listing is AT cap -> NEEDS-CHECK.

Only qualifying 3BR at the project. Common 3BR layout ~990 sqft FAILS size; larger 3BR are 1,152 / 1,206 sqft. PSF over cap. A 1,206 sqft 3BR transacted $2.20M on 2025-10-02, so $2.2M for ~1,150 sqft is market-consistent.

needs_check.reason: Built Dec 1996 - small freehold in the 1996-2000 window -> flagged NEEDS-CHECK per rule, not excluded. Attractive: under both caps, large 3BR. Range seen $1.85M-2.0M (1,292 sqft) and $1.95M (1,249 sqft).

3BR (1,281 sqft) clears size easily, but realistic market pricing is ~$2.3-2.4M (recent txns: $2.31M Apr'24, $2.31M Sep'24, $2.308M Mar'25, $2.35M Nov'25, ~$2.39M Aug'26) - at/over the $2.3M ceiling. Two anomalously low snippet listings ($1.55M/1,281 listed 03 Jul'26, $1.70M/1,270) look like stale/typo data - verify directly with agent before excitement.

Large 1,442 sqft 3BR would be a clean pass (project asking ceiling ~$1.6M => ~$1,110 psf, well under both caps), but no specific large-3BR listing confirmed live today - current live stock is concentrated in compact units. Worth a direct portal filter / agent query.

Most 3BR are 1,055-1,066 sqft (FAIL size); only the top handful (~1,120-1,163 sqft) exceed 1,110. No specific >1,110 sqft listing confirmed live (the one verified 3BR listing, 1,066 sqft @ $2,068,000, FAILS size). Watch the larger stacks.
Cheapest 3BR is $2,350,000 (1,313 sqft) - $50k OVER the $2.3M price cap and over the PSF cap. Negotiable, hence NEEDS-CHECK rather than clean fail. All other 3BR are 2,271-2,314 sqft @ $4.0-4.2M.
Large unit under both caps, but tenure / built-year / unit count unverified from snippets. Verify project fundamentals before considering.
Under price cap, PSF slightly over cap; tenure / built-year unverified from snippets. Verify fundamentals.

fail_but_noted.reason: PRICE FAIL - all current 3BR asking $2.65-2.70M (plus a $3.375M larger unit), well over the $2.3M cap; PSF ~$2,100 over cap. Size / tenure / lease all PASS. Buyer named it as THE example of rule (b).

fail_but_noted.reason: Qualifies on 99-yr rule (b) (437 units <= 500, 3BR 1,216/1,227 sqft > 1,110) and lease-age check, but ALL current 3BR asking $2.40-2.55M -> PRICE FAIL. Likely intended by buyer's 'The Waterline' label.
Under price cap, but ~702 units EXCEEDS the 99-yr rule (b) ~500-unit ceiling, so disqualified on tenure rule despite size fit. PSF over cap.
Boutique project; 3BR only as large/duplex penthouses. Only current 3BR listing is a $2,550,000 PH -> PRICE FAIL. No qualifying 3BR under $2.3M.
3BR (1,216-1,475 sqft) clear size, but current 3BR listings are $2.32M / $2.38M -> PRICE FAIL (just over cap). Also a label mismatch vs buyer's expected location.
Name-closest to 'The Waterline' but built 1993 (pre-2000, outside NEEDS-CHECK window) and 3BR 2,142-2,411 sqft @ $5.2-6.5M -> PRICE FAIL.
Shoebox development; all 3BR are penthouses ~807-850 sqft -> FAIL size. Recommend dropping from the 3BR >1,110 sqft watchlist.

fail_but_noted.project: Blossoms @ Woodleigh / The Gazania / The Lilium / Le Crescendo
fail_but_noted.reason: Blossoms 3BR 1,194-1,205 sqft but ~$2.77M (price fail); The Gazania 3BR 1,055 sqft (size fail) + $2.75M; The Lilium 3BR ~1,087 sqft (size fail, just under); Le Crescendo 1,313 sqft @ $2.38M (price fail, near-miss). Quality FH near Woodleigh/Bartley is either sub-1,110 sqft or $2.4-2.8M.

diff_vs_prior.note: Criteria changed materially since the 6 Jun baseline (size floor 1,000->1,110 sqft, price ceiling 2.2M->2.3M, bedrooms now 3BR+ mandatory, districts expanded to full D19 + D14 Eunos/Paya Lebar). Direct listing-level diff is therefore limited. Under the OLD criteria the three June matches (The Line @ Tanjong Rhu 1,055 sqft, Bliss @ Kovan 1,765 sqft 2BR PH, Flamingo Valley 1,701 sqft 2BR) would now mostly fail: The Line fails the 1,110 size floor, Bliss fails the 3BR rule (it was 2BR). Flamingo Valley re-appears today via a DIFFERENT, 3BR 1,152 sqft listing.
